reason.user_signing_key_changed: Your signing key changed, so you need to confirm them again.

state.blocked: Not sending keys because your own keys could not be checked

verification.confirmDescription: Confirm outside the channel (in person or another way) that they really replaced their keys. You will sign in again to confirm it is you before saving.

warning.own_identity_unknown: Your master key has not been checked yet. Unlock to check it.
warning.own_master_key_changed: The master key on the server differs from the one this device checked. No keys are sent to any device until you unlock again.
warning.untrusted_user_signing_key: Your user-signing key could not be checked. No keys are sent to other people.
warning.user_signing_key_rollback: Your user-signing key was rolled back to an old key that had been replaced. The server may have been tampered with, so no keys are sent to other people.
warning.user_signing_key_changed: Your user-signing key changed. People who were not re-signed need to be verified again.

authz.revokeSessions: In “Security”, sign out all sessions except this one (within 5 minutes of signing in again).
authz.disconnect: In “Connected services”, disconnect every zoo connection (Web, Android, TUI).
authz.disconnectAgain: In “Connected services”, disconnect every zoo connection again (signing in during the revocation issues new tokens).
authz.signOut: Finally, sign out on this device too, and sign in again.
authz.note: Deleting devices does not end sign-in sessions or tokens. Issued tokens work until they expire, so if you strongly suspect a takeover, also ask an administrator to suspend the account.
authz.acknowledge: I ended the sessions and disconnected the services in AuthZ

recovery.newDescription: After saving, the old recovery key no longer unlocks. Deleting or replacing a key slot is not revocation; if the old recovery key may have leaked, also revoke from the Devices tab.
recovery.removeDescription: This recovery key will no longer unlock. Keys already obtained stay valid. If it may have leaked, revoke.

e2ee.resetDevicesDescription: Select unfamiliar devices to delete them. If someone else set up encryption for your account, you must finish this choice before the reset completes so the attacker's devices are not left behind.
e2ee.resetDevicesConfirm: I selected unfamiliar devices (or confirmed there are none)

attachments.decryptFailed: Couldn't decrypt the attachment. Its contents may have been altered.
attachments.blocked: This file type is blocked for safety
